title: Gaea
summary: Procedural generation graphs of noise, walkers, filters and mappers, run from a seed and drawn into TileMapLayer or GridMap; graphs are .tres resources.
useWhen: A 2D or 3D grid game needs procedural maps such as islands, caves or dungeons, generated from a seed into TileMapLayer or GridMap, and a node pipeline written as a .tres graph fits the job.
avoidWhen: One noise threshold or a simple random walk is enough: a short script with FastNoiseLite and TileMapLayer.set_cell() does it without a graph.
